name: tubegrade
description: Find what's breaking out on YouTube and why: outlier videos, viral title and thumbnail formats, channel growth, similar channels, rankings, transcripts and comments, plus guided workflows for ideas, packaging and scripts.

interface.longDescription:
Find what's breaking out on YouTube, and why, with TubeGrade in ChatGPT.

With TubeGrade, you can:

• Find ideas that are proven to work: discover videos that beat their own channel's normal views (outliers), by topic or for any channel, with each video's outlier ratio.
• Package videos with proven patterns: see the title and thumbnail formats behind breakout videos, view the actual thumbnails, and find videos with look-alike thumbnails.
• Study any channel: subscriber and view growth over time, average views, upload cadence, its best-performing videos, and channels similar in topic and size.
• Learn from the best videos: read full transcripts with timestamps, for one video or a whole channel, to study hooks and structure, and mine comments for what viewers ask for.
• Spot rising creators: weekly rankings of the fastest-growing, breakout and most-subscribed channels, worldwide and by country.
• Plan and write with guided workflows: video ideas, your next video, titles and thumbnails, researched scripts with cited sources, competitor breakdowns and video teardowns.
• Keep track: follow competitor channels and save videos to folders in your TubeGrade account.

TubeGrade works from public YouTube data and does not access your private YouTube Analytics. Sign in with your TubeGrade account to connect.
